## Every player's stats, on your own website.

Players want to see their stats and where they rank. Owners want leaderboards on the scoreboard and a stats page to share. Usually that's three plugins and a web host. **xStats is one plugin: player stats, leaderboards, placeholders and a stats website your server hosts itself, with nothing to sign in to.**

**[Read the docs](https://plugins.xenastudios.co/xstats/)** · **[Report a bug](https://github.com/xena-studios/plugins/issues/new/choose)**

---

## Why server owners pick it

- **Every feature free.** No premium version, no early-access builds, nothing behind a Patreon.
- **History from day one.** On first start it reads every player's stats from your world's own files, so leaderboards aren't empty on launch day.
- **Playtime that leaves out AFK time.** Minecraft counts time spent away from the keyboard. xStats doesn't.
- **A website, built in.** No web host, no account. Or copy the same site to GitHub Pages or your own domain.
- **You won't feel it running.** One save every five minutes is its only repeating task. It reads each player on their own thread, a few a tick, from the counters the server already keeps: no listeners for kills, blocks or movement. Leaderboards are worked out during the save and answered from memory.
- **Private when players want.** `/stats private` takes a player off the website. No IP addresses are stored, and the site shows only the stats you choose.
- **Every change applies on reload**, except `storage`, `server-name` and `network`, which wait for a restart.
- **Paper and Folia.** One jar runs on Paper, Purpur and Folia.

---

## What it tracks

- **Any stat:** all of Minecraft's (`player_kills`, `mined:diamond_ore`, `killed:*`), added up however you like, and any PlaceholderAPI value, such as a balance or a jobs level. 14 stats are counted out of the box.
- **Leaderboards by day, week, month and all time,** in `/leaderboard`, in placeholders and as boards in your world, with banned players and anyone you choose left out.
- **PlaceholderAPI:** `%xstats_kills%`, `%xstats_kills_monthly%`, `%xstats_rank_kills_monthly%`, `%xstats_top_kills_monthly_1_name%`, for scoreboards, TAB and holograms.
- **Boards in the world:** `/xstats board add kills monthly`, as Paper text displays, no hologram plugin needed.
- **A stats website:** leaderboards with a podium for the top three, a page for every player with their best places and a chart of their last 30 days, server totals and search, in your server's name, logo and colours, dark or light, and made for phones. It's read-only, with nothing to log in to, a limit per visitor, and tested setups behind a reverse proxy or a Cloudflare Tunnel.
- **Build your own:** a documented, versioned JSON API, and documented database tables.
- **Networks:** several servers sharing MySQL, with network-wide leaderboards and one website.
- **A developer API** for other plugins to add their own stats and profile sections.

---

## What players get

- **`/stats [player]`:** anyone's stats and where they rank, online or not, with a link to their page on the website.
- **`/lb kills monthly`:** any leaderboard, a page at a time.
- **A page of their own** on your stats website, to share with friends.

Staff get `/xstats` (status, boards, website test and export, reload) with `xstats.admin`, which operators have.

---

## Up and running in a minute

1. Drop the jar in `plugins/` and start the server. Stats are kept in SQLite, with nothing to set up, and everyone's history is imported.
2. Try `/stats` and `/lb playtime`.
3. For the website, set `web.enabled: true` in `plugins/xStats/config.yml` and run `/xstats reload`.

Full setup, every setting and every permission: **[plugins.xenastudios.co/xstats](https://plugins.xenastudios.co/xstats/)**

**Requires** Paper 1.21.11 or newer (or Purpur or Folia) and Java 21 or newer. PlaceholderAPI is optional. SQLite out of the box, or MySQL/MariaDB.
